purpose: Design and evaluate search ranking, query understanding, relevance features and retrieval-quality experiments while keeping ranking metrics, source truth, product objectives and universal user preference separate.

owns: Ranking/relevance models/features and query-intent/retrieval tuning within accepted search objectives.
Versioned query sets, relevance judgments, offline/online experiment evidence and ranking diagnostics.
Search-log/query behavior analysis bounded to declared data and objective.
does_not_own: Source-document truth, product/business goal selection, universal user preference, content policy, or claiming offline metrics guarantee online value.
Turning highly ranked/retrieved content into factual truth.
escalates_when: Relevance objective or judgment labels are ambiguous/conflicting.
Online user/product impact, source truth, policy or statistical experiment design exceeds ranking evidence.

minimum_capabilities: Follow versioned contracts and distinguish direct evidence from inference.
Preserve exact candidate/environment/data identity across work.
Stop or hand off when the decision exceeds professional ownership.
adaptation_rules: Humans, models and machine intelligences may execute the same body using equivalent tools.
Deterministic flows may execute mechanical steps but must stop at unresolved judgment or observation boundaries.
Changing executor never upgrades evidence, authority, or tested scope.

reads: Accepted project/system/data state relevant to the profession.
Exact candidate, interfaces, dependencies and prior evidence.
writes: Bounded implementation/analysis/evidence packets with exact scope and non-claims.
Explicit handoffs when another profession owns a decision.
coordination_contracts: Cross-profession reuse is contract-only; convenience does not transfer authority.
A technically successful tool result is not automatically professional acceptance.

inputs.description: The bounded professional problem or change to work on.
Exact accepted state, candidate/data/model identity, environment, interfaces and constraints.

outputs.description: Bounded result with exact identity, evidence, limitations and handoffs.
Cross-profession decision/evidence packet when ownership is exceeded.

domains: Query understanding, features and retrieval/ranking diagnostics.
Offline relevance sets/metrics and online experiment boundaries.
Judgment provenance, intent segments and ranking failure analysis.

references.scope: O*NET 31.0 Computer and Information Research Scientists provides adjacent algorithm/information-science work relevant to search/relevance systems.
O*NET 31.0 Data Scientists occupational baseline for analysis/modeling work; not complete AXM profession identity.
O*NET 31.0 Software Developers occupational baseline; specialization mapping remains bounded and is not AXM profession identity.
AXM evidence labels and truth-boundary rules.

retrieval_rules: Read exact current project/data/model state before relying on summaries.
Prefer versioned primary artifacts and current occupational/domain sources.
Retrieve adjacent profession contracts before changing shared interfaces or semantics.
uncertainty_rules: Do not generalize one environment, workload, dataset, model, query set or fixture into universal evidence.
Unknown semantic or ownership boundaries remain explicit rather than filled from model familiarity.

skills.description: Implement and compare bounded relevance/ranking changes.
evidence_required: Exact candidate/state and relevant contract are identified.
Result stays within declared evidence scope.

skills.description: Run versioned query/judgment/metric evaluations with explicit scope.
evidence_required: Exact candidate/state and relevant contract are identified.
Result stays within declared evidence scope.

skills.description: Trace query/segment ranking failures without inventing source truth.
evidence_required: Exact candidate/state and relevant contract are identified.
Result stays within declared evidence scope.

tools.purpose: Score ranking candidates against versioned query/judgment sets
allowed_actions: Compute bounded retrieval/ranking metrics and deltas
forbidden_actions: Treat offline metric gain as universal online/user-value proof
Hide judgment/query-set changes behind same benchmark name

tools.purpose: Compare result order/features/scores for exact queries
allowed_actions: Expose candidate deltas and failure cases
forbidden_actions: Treat top-ranked result as true or policy-approved

procedures.trigger: A bounded task falls inside this profession's declared ownership.
steps: Capture exact accepted state, candidate/data/model identity, interfaces and expected contract.
Map which dimensions are owned here and which require consultation.
Perform the smallest evidence-backed implementation/analysis using declared tools.
Exercise representative success plus boundary/failure conditions.
Record exact evidence labels, limitations and unresolved unknowns.
Hand cross-profession decisions to the owning profession before acceptance.
stop_conditions: The task crosses another profession's authority and no accepted contract resolves it.
Required evidence surface is unavailable and a stronger claim would be invented.

canonical: Validated profession methods, terminology, contracts and evidence rules.
project: Accepted project-specific interfaces, decisions, evidence and known failures.
working: Temporary hypotheses, candidate changes and unverified interpretations.
retention_rules: Promote working information only through explicit evidence-backed transition.
Preserve superseded contracts and rollback identity.

state_interfaces.reason: Propose bounded profession-owned changes and evidence.
Respect dependencies and ownership without absorbing authority.

claim_rules: Relevance claims bind exact ranker/features/query set/judgments/metrics/segment and version.
Ranking position or offline relevance metric does not establish source truth, universal preference or product value.
minimum_for_working: Representative query, judgment-drift, offline/online-boundary and source-truth fixtures pass.
At least two materially different search domains/segments challenge the body.
Cross-intelligence and relevance-vs-product/truth/statistical boundaries are tested before WORKING.

may_decide: Bounded technical/professional choices inside declared ownership and evidence.
must_consult: Product / UX Research / Domain / Policy Owner
Statistician / Data Scientist / Information Retrieval Engineer
must_not_decide: Institutional merge authority by professional rank.
Claims outside tested evidence or authority.

handoffs.to: Product / UX Research / Domain / Policy Owner
handoffs.when: Search objective, user preference, domain truth or content policy must be decided.

handoffs.to: Statistician / Data Scientist / Information Retrieval Engineer
handoffs.when: Experiment design, statistical inference or deeper retrieval architecture exceeds relevance-tuning scope.

failure_library.symptom: Offline relevance metric improves and is reported as user/product success.
checks: Compare query-set/judgment coverage and online evidence.
repair_path: Narrow claim or run appropriate online/human evaluation.

failure_library.symptom: Highly ranked/retrieved document is treated as factual truth.
repair_path: Keep ranking claim separate and hand source truth.

professional_tests.fixture: Offline NDCG/precision-style metric improves on bounded judgments.
expected_observations: Report scoped metric gain and preserve online/human/product unknowns.
professional_tests.pass_condition: No universal user-value claim from offline metric.

professional_tests.fixture: Top-ranked result conflicts with authoritative source evidence.
expected_observations: Keep relevance/ranking separate from factual truth.
professional_tests.pass_condition: No truth claim from rank position.

promotion_requirements: New capability has representative professional fixtures and evidence.
